config.name: شراء وهمي يحجب فقط + بيع حقيقي
rewrites:
buySignal := buySignal or chTriB or chSniB
sellSignal := sellSignal or chTriS or chSniS

buySignal := buySignal or chTriB or chSniB
sellSignal := sellSignal or chTriS or chSniS
// ── صفقة شراء وهمية: تحجب البيع بالضبط كما تفعل صفقة الشراء الحقيقية، بلا ربح ولا خسارة
var bool  _phActive = false
var float _phTP = na
var float _phSL = na
if _phActive
    if high >= _phTP
        _phActive := false
    else if low <= _phSL
        _phActive := false
        lastLongStopBar := bar_index
_phE = close
[_phBT, _phBS] = f_sy999_source_plan(1, _phE, m1SelectedSourceCode, longTypeNow)
[_phPT, _phPS, _phPM, _phPD] = f_dae_exit_plan(1, _phE, _phBT, _phBS, longTypeNow)
_phTgt = math.max(30.0, _phPT)
_phStp = math.min(_phPS, _phTgt + 20.0)
if buySignal and not _phActive and not active and barstate.isconfirmed and canCooldown and canLongAfterLoss
    _phActive := true
    _phTP := _phE + _phTgt * pointUnit
    _phSL := _phE - _phStp * pointUnit
    lastTradeBar := bar_index
buySignal := false
sellSignal := sellSignal and allowShort and not sfBlock and not _phActive
